name: ios-factory
description: Scaffold iOS apps, onboard them onto shared PR checks and App Store Connect, and ship App Store releases interactively. Builds run on Xcode Cloud.

asc_key_id.title: App Store Connect Key ID
asc_key_id.description: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → Team Keys (App Manager role or higher).

asc_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect Issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: Shown above the Team Keys table.

asc_key_path.title: App Store Connect key file (.p8)
asc_key_path.description: Path to the downloaded AuthKey .p8. Only the path is stored; the key itself is never read into Claude's context. Suggested home: ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/

team_id.title: Apple Developer Team ID
team_id.description: 10 characters. developer.apple.com → Account → Membership details. Used for signing in new apps.

bundle_id_prefix.title: Bundle ID prefix
bundle_id_prefix.description: Reverse domain for new apps, e.g. com.yourname. A new app gets <prefix>.<appname>.

projects_dir.title: Projects folder
projects_dir.description: Where new app repos are created, e.g. ~/Desktop/Code.
